# Talk track

<!-- Generated by `npm run talk-track` from server/data (talk-track.json, scenarios.json, verticals.json). Do not edit by hand. -->

Open with the label: this is a simulated evaluator, not real PingGateway. Say what that buys you (the mechanics, instantly, with nothing installed) and what it does not (IG's own parse errors, route reload, handler chain).

The page is in Mock mode. Live is refused for now: there is no live lane, so nothing here reaches a real gateway. Press Live once to show the page saying so.

Presenter mode (P, or the Present button) hides the explanatory text and keeps the banner. Esc leaves it. Reset lab puts the routes, tokens, clock and diagram boxes back.

One line per story. Each is generated from the story data, filled with the cast of the Travel pack, so it cannot drift from what the lab runs.

| Story | Title | Say |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | Same path, chosen by host | Two routes match the same path. The host condition makes the door route win for its own host, and every other host falls through to the main route. |
| S02 | No route matches: a bare 404 | When no condition is true the gateway answers 404 with no body and no hint. The lab shows each condition and why it was false. |
| S03 | A broad route sorts first and shadows the specific one | Both routes match /mcp/flights. The lab assumes routes are tried in name order, so the broad one answers and the specific one never does. Renaming fixes it. |
| S04 | The \. trap: one backslash and the route is gone | Inside a quoted condition string only \' and \\ are legal escapes. Writing the natural regex \. makes the condition unparseable, the route is not loaded, and requests get a bare 404 while everything else looks fine. |
| S05 | The fix: [.] instead of \. | A character class matches a literal dot with no escape at all, so the condition parses and the route loads. |
| S06 | A negative lookahead keeps other doors out | The main route excludes /mcp/invest and /mcp/weather with (?!...). Those paths fall to their own routes; everything else under /mcp goes to main. |
| S07 | The challenge that broke a client: "Bearer , resource_metadata" | A script appended ", resource_metadata=..." to a param-less Bearer. The first auth-param is empty. One real client rejected it (reported earlier, not re-measured here). |
| S08 | The fixed challenge | With a space after the scheme and a comma only between params, the same 401 lints clean. |
| S09 | Three ways to break resource_metadata | An http URL, an unquoted URL and a missing hint each fail in a different way. |
| S10 | Revoked and unknown tokens are inactive | The mock AS answers {"active": false} and nothing else for a revoked or unknown token. The route turns that into 401 invalid_token. |
| S11 | A token expires on the virtual clock | Nothing sleeps: the lab moves its own clock. At exp the AS says inactive. |
| S12 | Right scope, wrong audience | The token is active and has the scope, but its aud names a different resource. The route refuses it with 401 invalid_token. |
| S13 | Insufficient scope is a 403 and names the scope | The token is fine but too narrow. The answer is 403, not 401, with error="insufficient_scope" and the scope the client should ask for. |
| S14 | 401 and 403 swapped | insufficient_scope on a 401, invalid_token on a 403, and a 403 that forgets the scope each break the contract in a different way. |
| S15 | A hostile condition is refused, not run | Deep nesting and huge conditions stop at fixed limits with a clear error. Nothing recurses past them and nothing is evaluated. |
| S16 | A catastrophic regex is refused before it runs | The classic (a+)+$ can pin a CPU for minutes. The lab analyses the pattern first and refuses it. |
| S17 | The introspection endpoint is down | With the mock AS unreachable the route cannot decide. The lab answers 503 and says plainly that how real IG answers here is UNVERIFIED. |

Never say whether PingGateway runs without a licence. It is UNVERIFIED.
